name: Mitsubuchi Yua
source:
She is a quiet and reserved member of the library committee, she's not good at socializing. Both of her parents are salary workers.

She is a childhood friend of Kei's, but has not spoken to him since he entered the school. She was traumatized by Ei's rejection and is timid about relationships.

She dislikes Serika because she has big breasts and is rich.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/sfc/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
